'''This individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as the warden of the clandestine prison facility in the depths of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] known as [[The Prism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], she was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], eventually attaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Due to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] employment of Force-users and other dangerous beings during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] found it necessary to reopen an ancient prison facility known as [[The Prism]]. Assigning her to the facility in secret to replace Master [[Skein]], the warden of the clandestine [[Space station/Legends|space station]] was attended by one hundred [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] to assist in the day to day operations of the facility.

[[File:Darth_Vader_kills_the_Prism_Jedi.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Darth Vader kills the Jedi.]]
At the end of the Clone Wars, the Order and the Republic were destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-run government which replaced the Republic as the leading power in the galaxy. Unaware of the regime change, the Jedi warden welcomed the next shuttle arriving at the facility as a friendly vessel. Expressing relief at seeing a visitor, she was cut down by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] before she was even able to reach for her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Vader came to the facility in order to heal the gravely injured [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]], who had been weakened during a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]]. He ended up using the warden's prisoners to help take back Coruscant, though all but [[Shonn Volta|one]] were executed after their victory.<ref name="GP3" />
